name: Alexander Key
label: Full-Stack Developer
summary: Full-stack developer with 10+ years building and running production Ruby on Rails applications end to end — architecture, payments, mobile apps with Hotwire Native, and the Linux servers they run on.

bullets: Built and scaled a restaurant management platform to 100+ restaurants and $250K+ in annual revenue by leading a small team of developers from architecture through launch — owning the full stack from Rails application code to production servers and CI/deployment.
Processed 8 figures in payment volume by architecting the online ordering system end to end — Stripe checkout and refunds, Uber delivery integration, order scheduling, and a full catering system.

Delivered the platform's most complex feature — live table management — by building real-time table-state synchronization across every device in the restaurant using ActionCable WebSockets, giving front-of-house staff a single live view of the floor.

Grew from front-end developer building static sites to lead developer running a small team over a 9-year engagement by progressively taking ownership of the platform's back end, infrastructure, and technical roadmap.

Modernized a legacy Rails 3 reservation platform by leading a ground-up rewrite to Rails 8 in 2025 — architecting the new application and building its production infrastructure from scratch, including Dokku server provisioning and a full CI/CD pipeline.

Expanded the platform into a new vertical — tour and boat charter operators — by designing and building an end-to-end private charter product: embeddable lead-capture widget, prioritized booking pipeline, quote/deposit/balance invoicing, digital waivers, and crew assignment with automated itineraries.

Enabled clients to track Google and Meta ad conversions across the entire booking funnel by white-labeling reservations onto client-owned subdomains — building the multi-tenant routing and per-client DNS/SSL provisioning behind it.

Replaced a barely-functioning legacy .NET platform for Greek house meal management by leading a small team through a ground-up Ruby on Rails rebuild — owning architecture, servers, and CI/CD from first commit to launch, now serving chapters across multiple universities.

Shipped iOS and Android apps from a single Rails codebase using Hotwire Native — members reserve meals and late plates against chef-published menus, with per-member allergy/dietary tracking, meal-plan limits and billing compliance, and printable kitchen prep lists.

Carried every client's historical data through the replatform by converting the legacy MSSQL database to PostgreSQL — reverse-engineering the old schema and migrating chapters, members, meal plans, and reservation history into the new domain model.
Modernized a city guide platform running on a ~17-year-old .NET codebase by rebuilding it from the ground up in Ruby on Rails as sole developer — maintaining and evolving it since.
Achieved rank #1 Google results for multiple competitive local keywords by pairing the rebuild with aggressive on-page SEO — content structure, technical optimization, and performance work.

Increased click-through rates on the site's highest-traffic pages by building in-house analytics and an A/B split-testing framework — measuring real user behavior, then iterating page layouts against live traffic.

skills.items: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, Hotwire (Turbo & Stimulus), Hotwire Native
